[operator-attested] NO-REGRESSION EVIDENCE, the independent check the standing rule requires beyond CI.

Broad local run against the implemented tree:
    tests/unit + tests/interfaces
    7749 passed, 31 skipped, 4 warnings in 1529.89s (0:25:29)
    exit code 0

Zero failures, zero errors. Notably ZERO edits to any existing test file were required by the relocation — the whole suite passes unmodified, which is the property the plan named as the revert signal: if moving the code had forced a test change, the cut would have been wrong.

Gerrit change 1157 is LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1. Under the project's standing rule that PASSING CI IS NOT SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE, this local run is the second, independent leg — CI proves the change builds and tests green in the sandbox; this proves it against the developer configuration this project actually runs its own gates on.
